subject: general
question: Which of the following states recorded the highest Schedule Tribes (ST) sex ratio in 2011, as per the Census of India data?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Goa**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Goa** recorded the **highest Scheduled Tribes (ST) sex ratio** in 2011 according to the Census of India data.
 
• The ST sex ratio in Goa was **1,046 females per 1,000 males**.
 
• Goa is known for having a relatively smaller percentage of the **Scheduled Tribes** population in comparison to other Indian states.
 
• The high ST sex ratio is an indicator of **gender parity** among tribal communities in Goa.
 
• The state has seen a growth in the tribal population in recent decades, with a focus on **preserving cultural heritage** and improving education and healthcare facilities.
 
• Goa has a mixed population with influences from **Portuguese colonial history** and indigenous tribal communities.
 
• The tribal groups in Goa include the **Gawdas**, **Kunbis**, and **Velips**, among others.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Mizoram**__

 __
 
• Mizoram had a high ST sex ratio of **1,007 females per 1,000 males**, but it was not the highest.
 
• The state is home to various tribes, such as the **Lusei, Hmar, and Chakma**.
 
• Mizoram has a well-developed education system that contributes to the strong position of women in tribal communities.
 
 
 
• **Arunachal Pradesh**__
 __
 
• Arunachal Pradesh recorded a ST sex ratio of **1,032 females per 1,000 males**, higher than Goa, but not the highest.
 
• The state is home to diverse tribal groups, including the **Apatanis, Nyishis, and Mishmis**.
 
• Gender equality and a strong focus on education have positively influenced the ST sex ratio in Arunachal Pradesh.
 
 
 
• **Tamil Nadu**__
 
 
• Tamil Nadu recorded a lower ST sex ratio of **981 females per 1,000 males** in 2011 compared to Goa and other states.
 
• The state has a large population of **Scheduled Castes (SC)** and a significant number of **Scheduled Tribes (ST)** mainly in hilly areas.
 
• Improved access to education and healthcare has contributed to the betterment of tribal populations in Tamil Nadu.
